subject.title: fix(google-vertex): retry transient pre-stream failures and stale ADC

question: Should Google Vertex gain default pre-stream retry behavior, and if so should it expose three new environment variables rather than use a fixed owner-level policy or an existing shared retry seam?
rationale: The requested change alters default provider failure behavior and introduces three operator-facing controls; correctness alone cannot determine the intended long-term contract.

options.title: Use a bounded owner-level policy
options.body: Keep the Vertex-only pre-stream and stale-ADC recovery, but use a documented fixed bounded policy with no new environment variables.

options.title: Approve the environment controls
options.body: Retain the three variables only with explicit rationale, documentation, clamped semantics, and fresh-install/operator proof.

options.title: Defer to a shared retry design
options.body: Pause the 429/503 portion until a maintained shared provider retry contract can represent it, while deciding separately whether ADC cache invalidation belongs here.

recommendation.title: Use a bounded owner-level policy
recommendation.body: Keep the Vertex-only pre-stream and stale-ADC recovery, but use a documented fixed bounded policy with no new environment variables.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the adjacent current-main Vertex ADC boundary and can assess the interaction with this proposal.
